config_name: Strix G16 16" — Core Ultra 9 275HX, RTX 5070 8GB, 32GB DDR5, 2TB SSD, 16" QHD+ 240Hz Nebula HDR

specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop 8GB (full ~115W TGP + boost)
specs.keyboard_notes: Per-key RGB, oversized Enter, no numpad on G16

battery.notes: ~90Wh. Line-typical: ~5-6h light use, ~1.5h gaming; users report ~1-2h worse than lab figures (see SHARED-strix-g16.md).

price.notes: BBY API 2026-11-24: regular $3,399.95 (no sale), sku 19338499, direct (non-marketplace). BBY customer rating 4.62/5, n=499.

offers.name: ASUS ROG Strix G16 16" 240Hz HDR Gaming Laptop - Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX - 32GB DDR5 - 2TB SSD - NVIDIA RTX 5070 - Windows 11 Home - Eclipse Gray

reviews.quote: a fast gaming notebook with an RTX 5080 Laptop, which is an excellent match for the native QHD resolution of its matte IPS panel... the faster Ryzen 9 9955HX has to make do with the RTX 5070 Ti Laptop (reviewed 5080 config; CA retail tops out at 5070)

praises: BBY customer rating 4.62/5 across 499 reviews — the strongest-reviewed Strix G16 listing in Canada
Full-TGP RTX 5070 keeps demanding titles smooth at native QHD+ with DLSS; cross-shoppers cite ~120 FPS averages beating similarly priced rivals
QHD+ 240Hz Nebula HDR panel is a genuine step up — bright, fast, G-SYNC/Advanced Optimus with MUX switch
2x DDR5 SODIMM + 2x M.2 slots: RAM and storage are user-upgradeable, unlike soldered-RAM thin rivals
Aggressive per-key RGB and Armoury Crate fan profiles; GPU-side stays cool in long sessions
complaints: Battery unplugged is short — ~5h light use, ~1.5h gaming; it is a plugged-in machine
Turbo fan mode is loud under load; headphone territory
Plastic chassis has more deck/lid flex than the aluminum Legion Pro 7 at a similar price
Bulky 240W+ power brick adds real weight to the bag
Occasional ASUS QC gripes in reviews: panel backlight bleed and dead-pixel roulette on some units

design_philosophy: ASUS's mainstream 16-inch Strix: full-wattage RTX 50-series GPUs and high-refresh Nebula panels in a serviceable plastic chassis, tuned for FPS-per-dollar rather than thinness. This 275HX/5070/32GB/2TB build is the flagship CA Strix G16 tier and the highest-volume listing (499 BBY reviews), and is used as the anchor config for the whole line in SHARED-strix-g16.md.
rating_notes: No pro review retrieved before the researcher hard-stop (rtings/NBC pages not fetched on 2026-11-24) — professional.avg_score null per SCHEMA; do not cite a Strix G16 pro score. Ratings inferred from dataset-anchored sibling lines (Legion Pro 7/7i RTX 5080 gaming 9.5/battery 4.0; OMEN Max 16 calibration in SHARED-strix-g16.md): RTX 5070 tier ≈ 9.5 − 1.5 = gaming 8.0; ai_ml 6.5 capped by 8GB VRAM; battery 4.5 per user-calibrated ~5h light use on ~90Wh; build 7.0 (plastic chassis vs aluminum Legion); upgradability 7.5 (2x SODIMM, 2x M.2).
